class.name: NetwPredictReplayEntry
class.brief_description: One transition past a basis, with the command that drove it.
class.description: A row of [method NetwPredictionEngine.replay_entries]. The pool composes it out of the tape and the input lane it holds, so a replay and a carry are handed the same account of what the owner drove rather than each rebuilding one. [method index] and [method label] are the same number on every tier except FRAME, where a transition is numbered by its tape entry and the command it ran is filed under the tick it was authored at.

method.name: index
method.description: The transition, in the numbering its schedule keeps.

method.name: input
method.description: The command this transition ran. Under FRAME an entry the clock repeated carries the command the last fresh entry authored, because the owner ran that sample again rather than authoring a new one.

method.name: label
method.description: The tick the command was authored at.
